messages:
alex_w: quick async here — saw a small SLO signal bump overnight on /v1/generate (global). what I did: checked alert history, looked at per-pool error spikes, muted one noisy rule to stop paging. blockers: need access to the cloud preemption logs for the dedicated pool to confirm cause. today: triage alerts, open debounce PR if noise persists.

priya: saw the same error cluster, mostly us-west-2 dedicated GPU pool. suspect instance preemptions + a short GC spike. i pushed an autoscale buffer up by 2 instances for the pool as a short-term mitigation.

morgan: can you paste the alert query you used? might want to scope to model=p70 to see if it's model-specific.

alex_w: sure — used this prom query to compute error rate over 5m:

```promql
sum(rate(http_requests_total{job="runtime",route="/v1/generate",status=~"5.."}[5m]))
/
sum(rate(http_requests_total{job="runtime",route="/v1/generate"}[5m]))
```

threshold we currently page at ~0.005 (0.5%) over 10m. the spike hit ~0.8% for two 5m buckets.

juan: created SRE-472 to track debounce + routing fallback work. will add checklist: add per-pool thresholds, review paging channels, and add a canary route that falls back to smaller model when errors spike.

sre-bot: Incident created INC-2026-314 — assigned to @morgan — priority: P2 — channel: #inc-2026-314 (automated).

morgan: i'll take the oncall triage this afternoon. plan: (1) look at instance preemption logs, (2) check KV cache eviction events for the time range, (3) verify if model quantization path caused slower tail latency. will report back here.

priya: note — infra said there were two maintenance events in us-west-2 around 03:12 and 03:45 UTC that might correlate. i filed INFRA-131 to follow up.

alex_w: action items: morgan owns triage + postmortem draft, priya to follow infra preemptions and update INFRA-131, juan to own debounce PR and add per-pool thresholds, i'll update the SLO dashboard to show per-pool error breakdowns and add the 5m/10m comparison.

morgan: quick question — do we want paging to go to @oncall-sre or a narrower group for noise like this? paging everyone is noisy.

juan: narrower group sounds good. propose: page oncall-sre + runtime-owners for infra-impacting alerts, otherwise send async to #eng-sre for now. i'll add that to the debounce PR.

alex_w: agreed. fyi runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/alerts/high-error-rate — follow the troubleshooting steps and capture top 3 hypotheses for postmortem.

priya: thanks — i'll add the infra timeline to INFRA-131 and drop a note in the incident channel.

alex_w: cool. i'll update the thread after triage. :thumbsup:
